issue_context.title: Fake client should support mimic graceful pod deletion
issue_context.body:
<!-- Feature requests are unlikely to make progress as an issue.

Instead, please suggest enhancements by engaging with SIGs on slack and mailing lists.

A proposal that works through the design along with the implications of the change can be opened as a KEP:
https://git.k8s.io/enhancements/keps#kubernetes-enhancement-proposals-keps
-->

#### What would you like to be added:
Fake client should support mimic graceful pod deletion. Although fake client supports `AddReactor/PrependReactor` to add  a customize `Reactor` to different requests, it doesn't pass DeleteOptions down to the `Reactor`.

https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/staging/src/k8s.io/client-go/kubernetes/typed/core/v1/fake/fake_pod.go#L121-L126

#### Why is this needed:
To mimic testing graceful pod deletion in my project.
comments:
/cc @caesarxuchao who volunteered to reply / explain / ask
Thanks!
/triage accepted

I think it makes sense to pass down the deleteOptions to the reactors. @chenchun do you want to make a patch?

I don't think the fake client should mimic other graceful deletion logics like handling finalizers. That's too complicated. If tests need to test our those behaviors, they can use the real apiserver.

Yes, I'll send a patch later.

> I don't think the fake client should mimic other graceful deletion logics like handling finalizers. That's too complicated.

I agree.
